title: SQL Injection in Product Search
description: The /rest/products/search endpoint is vulnerable to SQL injection attacks. The 'q' parameter does not properly sanitize user input, allowing an attacker to inject arbitrary SQL code. The payload '\'' OR '\''1'\''='\''1' successfully returns all products from the database.
impact: An attacker can extract, modify, or delete data from the database. This could lead to complete data compromise, authentication bypass, and potential server compromise.
remediation: Implement parameterized queries or prepared statements for all database queries. Validate and sanitize all user inputs. Use an ORM that provides automatic escaping of SQL queries.
